row.evidence: 6sense's Enable SAML SCIM article says SCIM is included in Advanced Security as an optional feature, not enabled by default, and must be requested through your Customer Success Manager.
row.notes: New row. 6sense publishes no prices: the pricing page shows Sales Intelligence packages with 'Book a demo' only, so every tier is Contact Sales. SCIM 2.0 (bearer token, no expiry) sits in the optional Advanced Security feature set (with audit logs, custom roles and SAML group-to-role mapping), enabled via the CSM; whether Advanced Security costs extra is not stated publicly, so the gate is 'Contact Sales'. SSO must be configured first (Descope-powered SSO portal, JIT on by default). New SCIM setups go through the Descope portal with IdP-tailored steps or a generic IdP; a legacy pre-integrated Okta OIN app supports SCIM only for customers who set up SSO before 13 Nov 2025. Deleting a user in the IdP disables them in 6sense. The pricing page blocks scripted fetches (Cloudflare); it was read via WebFetch.

plans.name: Sales Intelligence packages (Data Credits and/or Predictive AI)
plans.notes: SCIM, audit logs, custom roles and role mapping are 'Advanced Security' optional features enabled through the CSM; not tied to a named package publicly.

scim.plan: Advanced Security (optional feature, enabled via CSM)

auth.token_source: Settings > Security and Compliance > Identity and Access > Open setup portal (Descope self-serve portal) > SCIM configuration

endpoints.notes: Groups=false is documented for the legacy Okta OIN app (no Group Push); the Descope-portal SCIM setup does not say.

operations.notes: Update is documented ("keep user attributes in sync"); PUT vs PATCH not stated. An IdP delete disables the user rather than deleting it, so delete=false.

attributes.notes: Docs name the synced fields in plain language (first name, last name, email, status) without SCIM attribute paths; the unique identifier must be email.

roles.how: A default role is assigned at creation; roles are not updated through SCIM afterwards. SAML group-to-role mapping (Advanced Security) can assign roles at login.

limitations.text: Once SCIM is on, users can only be created, updated and disabled from the IdP (except pre-SSO users not in the IdP); JIT must be turned off.
Legacy Okta OIN app: no Group Push and no import; provisioning is one-way Okta to 6sense; only for customers who set up SSO before 13 Nov 2025.
Email is the only supported unique identifier.

scim.notes: The SCIM connector base URL is shown in the Descope setup portal and is not published.

user_api.notes: The public 6sense API reference covers data APIs (Company Identification, Firmographics, Lead Scoring, People Enrichment, People Search) with no user or seat management endpoints. Audit logs (Advanced Security) are viewed in the UI (last 30 days); no audit-log API is documented.

okta.notes: Legacy pre-integrated 6sense OIN app (create, update, deactivate, reactivate; no Group Push or import), only for customers with SSO before 13 Nov 2025. OIN page URL not found (okta.com/integrations/6sense/ 404). New customers use the Descope portal flow.

entra.notes: Entra is listed for SSO in the Descope portal; SCIM uses portal-tailored steps or generic IdP. No Entra gallery tutorial found (6sense-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Google Workspace listed for SSO in the portal; SCIM not stated.

onelogin.notes: Listed for SSO in the portal.

jumpcloud.notes: Listed for SSO in the portal.
